entities.name: Primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Enables mutual authentication between the UE and the network and provides keying material for subsequent security procedures.

entities.name: EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: One of two defined methods for primary authentication and key agreement using EAP.

entities.name: 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: One of two defined methods for primary authentication and key agreement using 5G AKA.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that participates in the primary authentication and key agreement procedure.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that participates in the primary authentication and key agreement procedure.

entities.name: Keying material
entities.description: Security keys provided by the primary authentication and key agreement procedure for use in subsequent security procedures.

relations.description: The primary authentication and key agreement procedure includes the EAP based method as one of its defined methods.
The primary authentication and key agreement procedure includes the 5G AKA based method as one of its defined methods.
The primary authentication and key agreement procedure provides keying material for subsequent security procedures.
The UE participates in the primary authentication and key agreement procedure.
The AMF participates in the primary authentication and key agreement procedure.
